mapper.insert: INSERT INTO coupon_operation_log (coupon_template_id, user_coupon_id, user_id, order_no, operation_type, operator_type, operator_id, reason, detail) VALUES (#{couponTemplateId}, #{userCouponId}, #{userId}, #{orderNo}, #{operationType}, #{operatorType}, #{operatorId}, #{reason}, #{detail})
mapper.select: SELECT id, coupon_template_id AS couponTemplateId, user_coupon_id AS userCouponId, user_id AS userId, order_no AS orderNo, operation_type AS operationType, operator_type AS operatorType, operator_id AS operatorId, reason, detail, create_time AS createTime FROM coupon_operation_log WHERE coupon_template_id = #{templateId} ORDER BY create_time DESC, id DESC

SELECT SUM(operation_type = 'CLAIM') AS claimCount, SUM(operation_type = 'LOCK') AS lockCount, SUM(operation_type = 'USE') AS useCount, SUM(operation_type = 'RELEASE') AS releaseCount, SUM(operation_type = 'EXPIRE') AS expireCount FROM coupon_operation_log WHERE coupon_template_id = #{templateId}
